instruction: How long is my workout duration on sundays, in minutes, as per my plan in Simple Note?
notes: Read-only question task: no database changes are allowed, so the model only chains lookups. passwords -> simple_note login -> search_notes(query='workout') discovers the workout-plan note id -> show_note reveals the Sunday workout duration (found-duration) -> complete_task passes that duration as the answer. The static facts note-matches and duration-of link the query to the note and the note to the answer object; the agent converts the Sunday entry to minutes at runtime (e.g. '1 hour' -> 60). The reference solution may include an extra inspection call (e.g. a second show_note or show_active_task); the minimal plan has 5 calls.
